name: notify-is-a-oneway-open-nobody-answers
description: A notify is exactly one open carrying end and oneway, and nothing else: no handle and no awaited result (WSM-API-005, WSM-FRM-020). The receiver's handler returns at once, and the receiver sends nothing on the stream: no implicit end, which WSM-STM-035 would send for an ordinary stream, and no reset (WSM-STM-040). The expect_no_frame steps on the acceptor are the assertion that matters.
